lines.text: At Beersheba Israel offered sacrifices, and God promised to go to Egypt with him and make him a great nation.
Jacob's sons took him to Egypt in Pharaoh's wagons, and the family took its livestock too.
Jacob's family numbered seventy, and Reuben went ahead for directions to Goshen, where Joseph met his father.
Joseph presented five brothers to Pharaoh, and they said they were shepherds who came because the famine was severe.
Jacob told Pharaoh his years were few and hard, and Joseph settled the family in the district of Succoth.
